description: This file provides a minimal wrapper around the fetch API for frontend services, facilitating consistent API calls and error handling. It includes utilities for URL joining, normalization, JSON/text reading, and a generic fetch function that returns a standardized response shape.

methods.name: joinUrl(baseWithTrailingSlash, pathNoLeadingSlash)
methods.description: Concatenates a base URL and a path, ensuring proper slashes.

methods.name: normalizeEndpoint(url)
methods.description: Ensures the URL has exactly one trailing slash.

methods.name: tryReadJson(resp)
methods.description: Attempts to parse a fetch response as JSON, returns null if parsing fails.

methods.name: tryReadText(resp)
methods.description: Attempts to read fetch response as text, returns empty string if fails.

methods.name: toErrorMessage({ json, text, status })
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly error message based on the response JSON or text.

methods.name: getBackendBaseUrl()
methods.description: Retrieves the backend base URL from environment variables, with normalization.

methods.name: apiFetchJson(path, { method = "GET", headers, body, baseUrl, allowRelative = false } = {})
methods.description: Performs a fetch request to a specified API endpoint, returning a consistent shape with error handling.

ctags.name: apiFetchJson
ctags.pattern: /^export async function apiFetchJson(path, { method = "GET", headers, body, baseUrl, allowRelative/
ctags.signature: (path, { method = "GET", headers, body, baseUrl, allowRelative = false } = {})
